about: Cases of tools/recall-eval.mjs, from the 1.6.0 design, section 'The gate'. All facts are made up. kind: gain (helps with pointers), control (memory has nothing to say: passes in both arms, and the hooks print nothing), misleading (runs with pointers only). check: answer / notAnswer are case-blind patterns on the final answer; noPointer, noSearch; fileHas [path, pattern]; exists / absent are project paths. find: a word of the case's seeded entry, searched before any paid session.
